Checking the carrier’s tracking page directly (for example UPS).
Refreshing the tracking page after the shipment is dispatched.
Waiting a bit longer, as carriers sometimes delay the first scan.
If tracking still hasn’t updated after the normal 7–10 business day window, it may mean the carrier hasn’t picked it up yet or the shipment is still being prepared.

My tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it, what now?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
If your tracking shows delivered but you didn’t receive the item, try these steps:
Check the delivery location – look around your door, porch, package lockers, or other common drop‑off spots. Sometimes carriers leave packages nearby.
Confirm the delivery address used during checkout to make sure it’s correct.
Contact the shipping carrier listed on your tracking and file a missing package investigation using the tracking number.
Keep documentation such as photos of the delivery area and your tracking details in case they’re needed for the investigation.
Also note that “delivered” in the system can sometimes mean the package was handed to the carrier or reached a local hub, not necessarily your home yet.
